title: The Prevalence of Lower Urinary Tract Symptoms (LUTS) in Poland
brief_summary: The first large population-based study to evaluate lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS) in Poland. The study objective is to assess the prevalence and bother of LUTS in the population aged ≥40 years in Poland.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Age \>40

Exclusion Criteria:

Age \<40 Pregnancy Urinary tract infection in the past 4 weeks
condition: To Evaluate Lower Urinary Tract Symptoms (LUTS) in Poland
